name: gc2
description: GC2 (Geo Compute Cloud) for Codex: the GC2 MCP server plus skills for runtime SDK usage, provisioning, JSON-RPC, auth, OGC/OWS services, snapshots, scheduler, realtime and delivery rules.

interface.longDescription: GC2 (Geo Compute Cloud) is a geospatial Backend as a Service on PostgreSQL/PostGIS. This plugin gives Codex the GC2 MCP server (tools generated from the GC2 OpenAPI spec: schemas, tables, SQL, OGC services, snapshots, scheduler, functions and more) plus skills for runtime SDK usage, provisioning, JSON-RPC, auth, OGC/OWS, map styling, realtime and delivery rules. Run `gc2 login` once so the server can use your session.
